about_page.hero_title: Born from necessity, built for impact.
about_page.hero_lede: Andjix Consulting Inc. is an administrative, tax, and professional support firm based in Ottawa.
about_page.section1_title: A bilingual business, grounded in the Canadian system.
about_page.section1_p1: Andjix Consulting Inc. was founded in Ottawa by André Djomamessi. Training in administration and taxation, complemented by Canadian experience. Over a decade in the private sector: business management, tax compliance, recruitment.
about_page.section1_p2: Settled in Canada for several years, André knows the administrative system, federal institutions and the real needs of newcomers well.
about_page.p1_desc: Operational experience of Canadian administration. Deep working knowledge of federal and provincial institutions and their procedures.
about_page.p2_desc: Postgraduate diploma in tax (D.E.S.S.), complemented by Canadian training in business administration. Mastery of the CRA and Canadian tax obligations.
about_page.p3_desc: Knowledge of the Canadian job market: CV adaptation, interview coaching, employer-candidate matching and placement follow-up.
about_page.why_p: Because classic welcome services do valuable work, but cannot always offer individual follow-through, in your language, by someone who knows the system from the inside. Andjix fills that gap.
about_page.why_quote: One point of contact, from start to finish.
about_page.v1_desc: Your documents and data are protected to PIPEDA standards. See our privacy policy.
about_page.v2_desc: No hidden fees. You know what each service costs before we begin.
about_page.v3_desc: We also handle sliding-scale files for clients in financial hardship.
about_page.cta_lede: Start with Andjix AI, or book a session with an advisor directly.

impots.title: Tax returns
impots.intro: Current-year returns and catch-up on past years. A fixed price announced upfront, a review with you before you sign, and follow-up on your notice of assessment. In English or French.
impots.table_caption: Tax return packages and fixed prices
impots.r2_incl: Two coordinated T1 returns, Canada Child Benefit, child care expenses
impots.r3_incl: Arrival date, world income, setting up credits and benefits
impots.r4_incl: T1 and T2125, business and vehicle expenses, GST/HST reminder
impots.r5_incl: Handled as a batch, one year at a time
impots.r5_price: Per year, confirmed after the meeting
impots.table_note: Prices before taxes. For the Self-employed and Catch-up packages, the price depends on your file: it is confirmed to you in writing after the free discovery meeting, before any work begins.
impots.incl2: Document upload through an encrypted portal
impots.incl3: Line-by-line review with you before you sign
impots.incl5: Explanation of your notice of assessment
impots.docs2: Most recent notice of assessment (if you have one)
impots.docs3: Receipts: child care, rent, medical expenses, donations
impots.docs4: Newcomers: arrival date and foreign income
impots.docs_note: Slips (T4, T5…) can be retrieved directly from the CRA with your permission.
impots.not_desc: Corporate returns (T2) and Quebec returns (TP-1). We can refer you to another professional.
impots.faq1_q: Can the price change along the way?
impots.faq1_a: No. The package and its price are confirmed in writing before we start. If something unexpected moves you to another package, we tell you before doing the work.
impots.faq2_q: How many past years can you catch up on?
impots.faq2_a: Most recent years can be filed electronically with the CRA. Older years are filed on paper. Either way, the price is announced upfront.
impots.faq3_a: They are uploaded to an encrypted portal, never by email. See our privacy policy.
